This Dot Labs | Senior Android Engineer (Kotlin), Senior React Native Engineer, Senior JavaScript Engineer, Software Architect | REMOTE

This Dot Labs is an AI-native software engineering consultancy with a remote-first, global team. We help companies design, build, modernize, and scale production software.

We are hiring experienced engineers for:

* Senior Android Engineer (Kotlin) * Senior React Native Engineer * Senior Software Engineer (JavaScript, React, Angular, Vue) * Software Architect

You will work directly with clients and collaborate with experienced engineers across time zones. We value strong communication, independent ownership, technical excellence, and active participation in the developer community.

Details and applications: https://www.thisdot.co/jobs

Questions: jobs@thisdot.co

Please mention Hacker News when applying.
